name: Shadra's Venom
summary: Shadra's Venom is taken from the spider god in the Hinterlands. Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill needs it after Shadra is summoned.

sections.title: Venom for Lydon
sections.body: At Shadra'Alor in the Hinterlands, the parchment calls Shadra from her lair. Her venom is carried to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill, who waits for it.

faq.answer: Shadra's Venom is taken from Shadra, the spider god of the Hinterlands.
Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill asks you to bring Shadra's Venom to him.

faq.q: Where do you get Shadra's Venom?
faq.answer: Shadra's Venom comes from Shadra at the altar of Shadra'Alor in the Hinterlands.
Read Gadrin's Parchment at the altar of Shadra'Alor, deep within the Witherbark realm in the Hinterlands.
